FIELD.NAME: groupcheckmode

FIELD.NAME: questionid

FIELD.NAME: name

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: Label shown to students.

FIELD.NAME: unit
FIELD.COMMENT: Unit shown to students.

FIELD.NAME: rangemin

TABLE.NAME: qtype_labcalc_results
TABLE.COMMENT: Calculated values the student must enter for a Lab calculation question

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key references question.id.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Name, usable as {name} in later formulas.

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: Label shown to students.

FIELD.NAME: unit
FIELD.COMMENT: Unit shown to students.

FIELD.NAME: formula
FIELD.COMMENT: Formula using {name} placeholders.

FIELD.NAME: tolerance
FIELD.COMMENT: Tolerance for full marks.

FIELD.NAME: tolerancetype
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = relative (percent), 2 = absolute.

FIELD.NAME: partialtolerance
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional wider tolerance for partial credit. Blank = none.

FIELD.NAME: partialfraction
FIELD.COMMENT: Fraction awarded within the partial credit tolerance.

FIELD.NAME: sigfigsmode
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = not checked, 1 = fixed number, 2 = automatic.

FIELD.NAME: sigfigs
FIELD.COMMENT: Required significant figures (fixed mode).

FIELD.NAME: sigfigsslack
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of significant figures more or fewer that is still accepted.

FIELD.NAME: sigfigspenalty
FIELD.COMMENT: Fraction of this result's mark removed for the wrong number of significant figures.

FIELD.NAME: weight
FIELD.COMMENT: Relative share of the question's mark.

FIELD.NAME: displaysigfigs
FIELD.COMMENT: Significant figures used when showing the expected value.
